package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"

	"github.com/cloudwego/eino/adk"
	"github.com/cloudwego/eino/components/model"
	"github.com/cloudwego/eino/components/tool"
	"github.com/cloudwego/eino/compose"
	"github.com/cloudwego/eino/schema"
)

type checkpointStore struct{ data map[string][]byte }

func (s *checkpointStore) Get(_ context.Context, key string) ([]byte, bool, error) {
	data, ok := s.data[key]
	return append([]byte(nil), data...), ok, nil
}

func (s *checkpointStore) Set(_ context.Context, key string, data []byte) error {
	s.data[key] = append([]byte(nil), data...)
	return nil
}

type checkpointModel struct{}

func (checkpointModel) Generate(context.Context, []*schema.Message, ...model.Option) (*schema.Message, error) {
	return nil, errors.New("unexpected Generate call")
}

func (checkpointModel) Stream(context.Context, []*schema.Message, ...model.Option) (*schema.StreamReader[*schema.Message], error) {
	return schema.StreamReaderFromArray([]*schema.Message{
		schema.AssistantMessage("", []schema.ToolCall{{
			ID: "call-confirm", Type: "function",
			Function: schema.FunctionCall{Name: "confirm_fixture", Arguments: `{}`},
		}}),
	}), nil
}

func (m checkpointModel) WithTools([]*schema.ToolInfo) (model.ToolCallingChatModel, error) {
	return m, nil
}

type confirmationTool struct{}

func (confirmationTool) Info(context.Context) (*schema.ToolInfo, error) {
	return &schema.ToolInfo{Name: "confirm_fixture", Desc: "requires confirmation"}, nil
}

func (confirmationTool) InvokableRun(ctx context.Context, _ string, _ ...tool.Option) (string, error) {
	return "", compose.StatefulInterrupt(ctx, "approval required", "pending action")
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 2 {
		panic("usage: fixture-generator OUTPUT")
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	agent, err := adk.NewChatModelAgent(ctx, &adk.ChatModelAgentConfig{
		Name: "confirmation", Description: "checkpoint compatibility seam", Model: checkpointModel{},
		ToolsConfig: adk.ToolsConfig{ToolsNodeConfig: compose.ToolsNodeConfig{
			Tools: []tool.BaseTool{confirmationTool{}},
		}},
	})
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	store := &checkpointStore{data: make(map[string][]byte)}
	runner := adk.NewRunner(ctx, adk.RunnerConfig{
		Agent: agent, EnableStreaming: true, CheckPointStore: store,
	})
	const checkpointID = "u:7:t:pre-upgrade-confirm"
	var rootInterruptID string
	iter := runner.Run(ctx, []*schema.Message{
		schema.UserMessage("perform confirmed action"),
	}, adk.WithCheckPointID(checkpointID))
	for {
		event, ok := iter.Next()
		if !ok {
			break
		}
		if event.Err != nil {
			panic(event.Err)
		}
		if event.Action != nil && event.Action.Interrupted != nil {
			for _, interrupt := range event.Action.Interrupted.InterruptContexts {
				if interrupt.IsRootCause {
					rootInterruptID = interrupt.ID
				}
			}
		}
		if event.Output == nil || event.Output.MessageOutput == nil || event.Output.MessageOutput.MessageStream == nil {
			continue
		}
		stream := event.Output.MessageOutput.MessageStream
		for {
			_, recvErr := stream.Recv()
			if errors.Is(recvErr, io.EOF) {
				break
			}
			if recvErr != nil {
				panic(recvErr)
			}
		}
		stream.Close()
	}
	data := store.data[checkpointID]
	if len(data) == 0 || rootInterruptID == "" {
		panic("checkpoint or root interrupt ID was not emitted")
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(os.Args[1], data, 0o644); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(os.Args[1]+".root-id", []byte(rootInterruptID+"\n"), 0o644); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("wrote Eino v0.9.6 checkpoint: %d bytes\n", len(data))
}
